featured_reviews.review_text:
When Michelin comes to India, this restaurant is getting a Bib Gourmand!

Had the Thai Tea without Boba, and frankly it took me back to the roadside restuarants of Ubon and Lampang in Siam! It tasted soo original and authentic; never experienced it anywhere in Mumbai.

The staff himself was very courteous and kind, prepared the tea and served with a smile.

Will recommend the spot 10/10

featured_reviews.name: Indrani Sen
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited this new outlet of Makan Lah at Lower Parel while visiting palladium mall! This cozy little restaurant serves up bold flavors and an authentic vibe, with charming interiors and a lovely street view.

We tried their coconut milk tea with coconut jelly—super refreshing and my recommendation is The Kopi Peng (iced coffee) with popping boba For starters, as a seafood lover tried  the garlic prawns and chicken gyoza with juicy, spicy chicken filling, served with  chili oil and soy sauce.

In mains, we went for the Hainanese chicken rice, and it was spot on. The poached chicken breast was incredibly tender, and the rice—cooked in rich chicken broth and fat—was packed with flavor. It came with a side of fresh salad and a sweet chili dipping sauce.Overall, it was a delightful experience.

featured_reviews.name: Appetites India
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are also the one who loves Singapore food and want to explore then you should surely try this place, they have a good menu to try from

We tried some amazing dishes! The Kaya Toast which was buttery and sweet with coconut jam. The jam is their in house recipe. Loved the Hainanese Chicken Rice, it was so tender and fragrant something new we tried.

Then had the Chicken Gyoza pan fried dumplings which was best and the Spring Rolls which were crispy and juicy. Lastly we had the Coconut Curry Mee was rich and flavorful, and to end our meal we had the Mango Milkshake Boba too good

featured_reviews.name: Utkarsh Dalal

featured_reviews.name: jd

I've never tried Singaporean cuisine before, but Makan Leh really surprised me with their food! Here are my recommendations:

- Thai Milk Tea: Simple, yet perfect - a must-try!
- Mango Matcha Latte: A dream come true for matcha lovers!
- Chicken Gyazo: The chicken was juicy and flavorful, like a flavor bomb!
- Nasi Lemak Chicken: A perfectly balanced meal, full of goodness!
- Wantan Chilli Noodles (dry): This spicy dish has won my heart - I'll definitely order it again!

My overall experience was lovely, and I'll be back soon!

featured_reviews.name: Tanishka Rajpal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Loved the vibe and food here!
Stumbled upon Makan Lah next to Phoenix Palladium and it was such a good decision. The ambience is super cute and cozy — perfect for chilling with friends.
We tried the Chicken Gyoza, Horfan Chicken Noodles, Tofu with Veggies & Rice, and a couple of their boba drinks — Strawberry Matcha and Strawberry Matcha Latte. Everything was fresh, flavourful, and honestly better than expected.
Also loved how friendly the staff was. Definitely a spot I’ll be visiting again. Great experience overall!

featured_reviews.name: VlogWithFurkan
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re craving authentic Singapore street food in Mumbai, Makan Lah is the place to be! 🇸🇬🍜

We tried their Chicken Chilli Dumplings – perfectly crispy and packed with juicy, spicy filling. The Chicken Spring Rolls were golden and crunchy, absolutely delicious! For drinks, we had the Pineapple Mojito, which was super refreshing, and the Strawberry Milk Tea, which was creamy and full of flavor – a must-try for bubble tea lovers!

In the mains, the Char Kway Teow Chicken had that perfect smoky wok-tossed taste you’d expect from a Singapore hawker stall. And the highlight was definitely the Sambal Chilli Chicken with Rice – spicy, flavorful, and truly comforting.

The ambience is casual yet vibrant, and the service was great too.
Highly recommended for anyone looking to explore unique Asian flavors in the heart of Mumbai! 🌟

featured_reviews.name: Anita Rane
featured_reviews.review_text:
One star for my past experience with Mag Street — or else, it would be zero.

About a fortnight ago, I ordered the cream cheese cruffin, only to discover it had been dusted with granulated salt instead of sugar. One bite was enough to make me gag, and that overwhelming salty aftertaste lingered for over three hours.

While a replacement was eventually delivered after we raised the issue, I also tried reaching out to the owner, Ms. Devidayal, via LinkedIn. Unfortunately, her response came across as dismissive and indifferent — a “too busy to care” kind of attitude.

This disappointing experience and lack of accountability is what compelled me to leave this review.

featured_reviews.name: Satyabrata Nandi
featured_reviews.review_text:
The food menu carries some of the best dishes to be seen in Bombay or even any of the renowned fine dining eateries in India. The presentation is only surpassed by the delectable but subtle mix of flavours.

I can think of a number of restaurants in the city who would do well to take a page out of the Mag Street book on how to make your guests feel welcome and at home!
Atithi Devo Bhava.. the phrase may not have been coined here, but the wonderful people at Mag Street more than embody it.

The only fly in the ointment, a small one at that, is the generous helping of ice which is part of their cocktail selection. A tad less of the frosty would help the palate enjoy the myriad flavours better.

I have been a regular eater over here and especially I have eaten 'Cheese Chocolate Sandwich' quite many a times. This review is collectively based on my more than two times eating experiences over here. My orders have been-
1) Cheese Chocolate Sandwich-
Price Rs 90/-
It tastes the best when eaten hot, so don't miss out on eating it right away when its served.
2) Pav Bhaji-
Price approx Rs 50-60
The finely chopped bhaji is very yummy and perfectly cooked. It tastes delicious with butter tossed little Pavs(buns)
3) Schezwan Maggi-
Price approx Rs 50-60
This is my second most favourite bite from here. It is spicy, delectable and tangy at the same time.

4) Veg Grilled Sandwich-

featured_reviews.name: Radhika Shankar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Popular is a small sandwich joint in Lower Parel which has food offerings at a very nominal rate. Having tried their home delivery service, I found the service to be very prompt. Popular will definitely earn brownie points for quick delivery and neat packaging.

As for the food, here’s what I tried:

1. Veg Grilled Sandwich
This is your regular roadside grilled sandwich stuffed with chopped onions, tomatoes, capsicum and potatoes. There’s a mildly spiced coriander chutney which is spread in all the sandwiches. Since you can’t really go wrong with a sandwich like this, it’s worth a try.

2. Corn Cheese Grilled Sandwich
I had high expectations from this sandwich but found it to be very disappointing. Again, the coriander chutney spread was in it and it absolutely did not complement the boiled corn and capsicum. The cheese had hardened by the time it had reached so the taste was close to awful. Definitely would not recommend this.

3. Samosa Grilled Sandwich
As the name suggests, the sandwich is stuffed with a deconstructed samosa. The filling was slightly spicy and the sandwich had a very desi taste to it. It’s a heavy sandwich and definitely not for someone who doesn’t like to experiment with sandwiches.

4. Plain Garlic Bread
The garlic bread, which looked burnt in the first go didn’t falter on taste. I expected it to be disappointing but the garlic bread tasted surprisingly good. With chucks of garlic stuffed on top of a sesame bun and generous helpings of butter spread on top, this garlic bread is worth a try.

Overall, I wouldn’t rate the quality of food very high. Perhaps having the sandwiches freshly made at the restaurant would taste better but would not recommend their delivery service. The only highlights were the reasonable rates, prompt service and proper packaging of the food.

Hitchki, located at High Street Phoenix, Palladium, is my personaly favourite venue. Recently visited this plave on a special occasion of my Birthday and it really was a superb experience and made my day more special and joyful.

Visited here for a brunch and we received great hospitality. It is the best place in town to party, chill and celebrate. Ambience was lit with great music and lively interiors. It is a bollywood retro themed bar with fusion food and vibrant ambience.

They have large varieties of food options with their names in a unique style that will make you exciyed to try and taste. We enjoyed all of their dishes which were specially curated.

For appetizers we had :
1. Hitchki Dosa Poppers
2. Pav Bhaji Satakli

Cocktails were really lit and it was cool enough to hit us in a right mood. Literally made our time more vibing and chill. We tried following Cocktails :
1. Aatmanirbhar
2. Malta Mojito
3. Swaadika
4. Koffee with K

In Main course, we ordered :
1. Kadai Paneer Lasagna
2. Harry Pot Rice

Ended up with Chew-Roz dessert which was very unique and tasty. Cannot get over the delicious varieties of food, cocktails and dessert. One memorable experience at Hitchki and i must say its a all time go to place for party lovers.

Cheers to the management.

featured_reviews.name: akshay kate
featured_reviews.review_text:

So from Drinks, we ordered Minions, which has watermelon juice in a wine glass, and He-Man, which tasted good.
In the main course,we ordered pot rice, which has a huge quantity and lots of gravy, which tastes juicy.

featured_reviews.name: Lavith k
featured_reviews.review_text:
“A cozy spot in Phoenix Mall with great vibes and even better service!”

Situated in the bustling Phoenix Mall, this pub offers a cozy atmosphere with a good ambience that feels welcoming and lively. While the space is a bit congested, it adds a bustling charm that some may find enjoyable. The bar area is well-designed and serves as a great spot to relax with friends.
The food, however, is average and doesn’t quite match the appeal of the surroundings. It’s decent for a quick bite but might not satisfy more refined tastes.
What truly stands out is the staff. They are incredibly polite, attentive, and efficient, ensuring a pleasant experience overall. If you’re in Phoenix Mall looking for a friendly spot to unwind, this pub is worth a visit, especially for its service and lively vibe.

featured_reviews.name: Yashashri Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an amazing evening at this place, such a beautiful ambience and super delicious food. Hitchki is worth visiting.

Ordered :
- Boot- E-Licious
- Dum Maaro Dum
- Sriracha Fish Tilla
- T.icken Chikka
- Chicken Chilli Garlic Noodles
- Chicken Harry Pot Rice
- Pull Me (Cheese Cake)

Boot- E-Licious and Dum Maaro Dum both the cocktails were something different I loved both.
Sriracha Fish Tikka was juicy and delicious it was served with kasundi mayo.
T.icken Chikka which is actually chicken tikka it came with naan and mint chutney. It was not only well presented but tasted really good.
Chicken Chilli Garlic Noodles was nice it came with super hot and lil spicy chicken chilli gravy.
Chicken Harry Pot Rice was served sizzling hot it was mildly spicy and had lots of exotic veggies.
Pull Me Cheese Cake was yummy and it's a must try Dessert I just loved it.

The food was super delicious. Service was quick and the friendly staff helped us choose the best items from the menu. The ambience was beautiful and the rocking music made my evening amazing.

Food - 5/5
Quality - 5/5
Quantity - 5/5
Price - 5/5
Service - 5/5
Overall - 5/5

This place is highly recommended. I am surely going to visit again.

featured_reviews.name: Siddhi Parekar
featured_reviews.review_text: I had visited Hitchki restaurant in Palladium with my friends to chill as I have heard a lot about this restaurant. To begin with their menu has wide range of options and all quite tempting. We ordered a couple of things. We ordered Chicken tikka gravy with paratha, noodles, chicken wings and hot cake with kulfi.   Kulfi was the best part. The food was really delicious and the presentation of the food was making it more appealing. The ambience of the place was amazing. They have huge bar counter and DJ. We enjoyed a lot there. It was a whole different luxurious vibe and we had a memorable experience. Would love to dine in here again.

featured_reviews.name: Prachiti Gadekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
The most happening Bollywood themed place has opened its door at Palladium mall, lower parel and how can I miss on it😍

The place has fully equipped bar with variety seating and rock ambience to make your day

Alcohol lovers are welcomes here with unique and innovative drinks. We started with Aatmanirbhar Drink basically make your own drink with a twist😍 then sweety Tweety a peach and minty drink. In mocktails tried Superman and loved it totally.

For starters do opt for Chicken sriracha dimsum comes with fab dips and tastes great. We ordered prawn Jaye par... somewhat unique tasted prawns I ever had with butter garlic and cheesy taste.

For mains we opted for CTM Karo which was served in tarajoo and prawns nasi goreng. The taste was just fab.

Finally not to miss is the dessert called pull me up with cheesecake base and caramel, berry compote filling. Very innovative has first time in my life but loved to the core❤️

I would highly recommend going and trying bollywood style food and great drinks here at Hitchki

featured_reviews.name: Sakshi Andhare
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hichki is one of the finest restaurants in Mumbai. Here you can try various dishes and the most important thing is that these dishes are given unique Bollywood style names.

The ambience of Hichki Palladium Outlet is very cool. The bar section is very nice and big. We first tried the deshi daru cocktail and the Minions mocktail. Both the drinks were served in a very unique way.

Coming towards starters we had tiger jhinga hai the dish presented with dry ice and taste of dish is even better. This is a must try starter for every prawns lover. Along with this we had steam bao stuffed with cahsews and tikka chicken.

Talking about mains we had Main tunhare tadke ki daal banne wali hu... Desi Dal Tadka Served with jeera rice, papad and pickle. If you are love North indian food then go for it... In dessert I tried their Moong Bharo Sajna combination of shahi tukda tukda and rabdi topped with rose brittles do try this.

Overall Excellent Experience...Do Visit And Enjoy!!!

featured_reviews.name: Nitika Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the finest places in Mumbai for lip smacking middle eastern treats !!!!

This place is mesmerising beyond words that you simply cannot stop admiring for its warm eyecatching beauty .From the ceiling to the walls to the seating to the flooring to the food ; every inch of this place is designed to give the quintessential Arabic feel .

The soothing Turkish music , lanterns in the shape of hot air balloons dangling at the ceiling , blue pottery inspired wall artifacts , matt gold wrought iron chairs with colourful suede fabric couch seating , sheesha show pieces kept at the French windows covered with flowing draped curtains .

The menu is vast & quite interesting & unusual as it starts left to right on the lines of Urdu script .

I tried the following items :

Baklawa .
Triangle shaped phyllo pastry layered with pistachio & rich cream .The use of homemade gulkan ( rose pettles jam ) entices every single nerve & the most thrilling aspect is nitrogen dipped fresh rose flower which is crushed live on your table on top of the Baklava .
An experience which shouldn't be missed !

Muhamara served with Pita Bread .
Deep red coloured muhamara was made of North African chillies , cirano peppers , mughrabe chillies generously garnished with walnuts .
I have to make a special comment that I have never seen or eaten such super soft fluffy round pita bread roti's ever served in fabric lined cane baskets .The plates were licked clean ! Yummy !!!!!!

Pide
Long rectangular boat shaped Turkish flat bread having stringy mozaerella cheese , Feta cheese , kashkaval cheese , bell peppers , thyme , zucchinin & squash .This was Comfort food at its best .The thin crisp bread was baked to perfection .Must Order !

Chocolate Fondant .
This picturisque dessert looked like a masterpiece artwork .The plating was simply jaw dropping with soft spongy chocolate cake having moltern chocolate inside served with fresh strawberries , chocolate caviar & chocolate soil garnished with edible flowers & vanilla icecream . Eve

One of the finest places in Mumbai for lip smacking middle eastern treats !!!!

featured_reviews.name: Hussein Hammoud
featured_reviews.review_text: Definitely not an authentic lebanse restaurant. You can immediately know from reading the menu. I ordered the Batata Harra which was surprisingly Excellent. Hummus which was Ok, just not as thick as the Lebanese authentic one. Chicken shawarma and that was nothing related to shawarma and didn't taste like one. The desert was good.

featured_reviews.name: jd
featured_reviews.review_text:
When it comes to Middle Eastern and Mediterranean cuisine, without a doubt, Bayroute is at the top of the game! The ambiance of this place is just so beautiful; it literally took me to the Middle East!

Me and my friend ordered a bunch of dishes and drinks like Hibiscus Cooler: this is a gin-based cocktail and had a very nice floral taste, with a light tanginess of olive, totally won my heart!

In food, I ordered Musabbaha Hummus and it was smooth and creamy; I really like the taste and could come to Bayroute just for hummus - 5/5!

Next, we tried their Harrisa Chicken Manakeesh: this was Lebanese-style pizza, and the best part was that it was loaded with chicken, and caramelized onion together gave it a really nice taste.

My second-last dish was Kuzu Pide: this pide had pulled lamb filling, and the lamb was so tender and flavorful; I really enjoyed it!

Last but not least, in dessert, I ordered Kunafeh Jibneh: this is a very popular Middle Eastern dessert, and everyone should try this at least once.

My overall experience was nice and heartwarming, and I'll be coming here soon! 😊

We visited KOKO, Lower Parel, on a completely last-minute plan. Their lunch service goes on till 4:00 pm, with the last order taken at 3:15 pm. Luckily, we managed to reach just in time at 3:10 pm.

We ordered the KOKO Signature Roll (avocado, tempura asparagus, crisps, and KOKO sauce) along with Hong Kong Soy Noodles with chicken.

The sushi was the absolute highlight for me – crisp, fresh, and packed with layers of flavour. Every bite was a delight, and it’s definitely something I would love to come back for. The noodles, on the other hand, had a very balanced and subtle taste, making it a nice complement to the meal.

featured_reviews.name: Dr. Minal Kabra
featured_reviews.review_text:
KOKO, Lower Parel – A Luxe Asian Dining Experience

KOKO in Lower Parel offers a refined and memorable dining experience. The ambiance is top-notch — modern, elegant, and perfect for an evening out. The menu features an impressive variety of sushi and dim sum, with ample vegetarian choices that are just as flavorful and thoughtfully prepared as the non-vegetarian options.

The staff is courteous and attentive, adding to the overall premium feel of the place. However, a heads-up for first-timers — they don’t usually offer tables without a reservation, even if some appear to be vacant. Be prepared to sit at the bar if you walk in without prior booking.

That said, once you’re seated, the food and experience are absolutely worth it. For anyone who appreciates quality Asian cuisine in a sophisticated setting, KOKO is highly recommended — just make sure to reserve in advance!
